description: Designs a hairpin molecular-beacon probe: GC-rich complementary stems (stem5 = ⌊stem_length/2⌋ Gs + remaining Cs, stem3 = its reverse complement) flanking the best target-specific loop of probe_length bases, for real-time detection. The reported Tm is the loop (probe–target) Tm (Primer3 seqtm) and Start/End mark the loop in the target; warnings carry the ntthal stem-loop Tm (beacons ≤ max_align_length nt, default 60). With detection_temperature T the loop Tm window is [T+7, T+10] °C and the stem-loop Tm is checked against T+7 °C (Tyagi & Kramer molecular-beacon rules). Returns probe=null when the target is shorter than probe_length.

detection_temperature.description: Optional detection (annealing) temperature in °C for the Tyagi & Kramer 7–10 °C rules.

max_align_length.description: THAL_MAX_ALIGN of the ntthal stem-loop (hairpin) Tm: longest beacon (nt) that gets it (default 60 = Primer3; opt-in 61..10000 = thal.c compiled with -DTHAL_MAX_ALIGN, for beacons longer than 60 nt).

probe.description: Beacon Probe (Type = MolecularBeacon) or null when the target is too short.

errors.message: Target sequence cannot be null or empty
